propwash.trick.type.anti_matty.desc: The Matty flip backwards: over an obstacle, throttle off, a full backflip, then level out with throttle – you fly back the way you came, tail first.
propwash.trick.type.backwards_dive.desc: Fall with the nose up: throttle off, tilted back, sink fast for at least 12 m, then recover.
propwash.trick.type.barani.desc: Half a power loop, a 180° inverted yaw at the top, then a Matty flip back under the obstacle – you end up looking back.
propwash.trick.type.coin_drop.desc: Cut throttle and drop while spinning upright around the yaw axis – like a falling coin. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.corkscrew.desc: A slow roll with throttle on while you keep flying: the drone screws itself along its line (barrel roll). Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.dive.desc: Nose down and drop at least 12 m fast and steep, then catch it. Every metre over 10 m counts.
propwash.trick.type.double_flip.desc: Two flips in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.double_roll.desc: Two rolls in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.double_yaw_spin.desc: Two yaw spins in one go.
propwash.trick.type.eject.desc: The Sbang basic move: tip hard, punch full throttle and snap straight back to level – the drone shoots off flat.
propwash.trick.type.flip.desc: A full turn on the pitch axis, forwards or backwards. Counts from about 250°.
propwash.trick.type.flip_3d.desc: 3D mode only: a flip where you switch to reverse thrust while upside down instead of dropping. Every extra flip counts.
propwash.trick.type.flip_rewind.desc: A full flip or roll and straight back the same way – like a video playing in reverse.
propwash.trick.type.funky_split.desc: A split-S done parallel to the obstacle: half roll onto your back, half flat spin (yaw) upside down, then upright – you end up looking back.
propwash.trick.type.gap.desc: Fly fast through a gap at most two blocks wide or high without touching it. Narrower is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.guillotine.desc: Climb high, dive straight down and flip out just above the ground, catching the dive. From 8 m drop; higher is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.half_matty.desc: Half roll to inverted, then the second half of a Matty flip forward with throttle: you carry on tail first, looking back.
propwash.trick.type.hammerhead.desc: Pull up steeply, yaw the nose over at the top, dive back down and recover – the stall turn from aerobatics.
propwash.trick.type.immelmann.desc: The opposite of a split-S: half loop upwards, then a half roll upright – reverses direction and gains height.
propwash.trick.type.immelmatt.desc: Combo: an Immelmann straight into a Matty flip, at most 0.8 s apart. Bonus on top of both tricks.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_360_power_l: A power loop with a full inverted yaw spin at the top, then finish the loop.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_flight.desc: 3D mode only: fly or hover upside down on reverse thrust without falling – at least 1 s. Longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_hang.desc: Hang upside down without turning for at least 0.9 s. Longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_hover.desc: 3D mode only: hover upside down on the spot with reverse thrust for at least 1 s, barely moving. Longer scores more.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_yaw_spin.de: Upside down, a full turn on the yaw axis, then back upright. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.juicy_flick.desc: Flick forwards into a half flip until you are upside down, then a half roll back upright: you end up looking back where you came from.
propwash.trick.type.knife_edge.desc: Roll onto your side and hold a straight line for at least half a second. Longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.matty_flip.desc: A full flip with a punch while you face backwards or upside down, which turns your flight around: you end up flying back the way you came.
propwash.trick.type.maverick_loop.desc: A loop over an obstacle with the camera looking forward the whole time: the drone only tilts a little and never goes inverted.
propwash.trick.type.mctwist.desc: Half flip onto your back, a full yaw spin, then finish the flip in the same direction – named after the skateboard trick.
propwash.trick.type.orbit.desc: Circle around a point with the nose pointing inwards, once per full circle.
propwash.trick.type.power_flip.desc: A power loop with a flip at the top – backwards or forwards – then finish the loop.
propwash.trick.type.power_loop.desc: Throttle up and pitch back through a whole vertical loop, usually over an obstacle, then fly on in the same direction.
propwash.trick.type.power_loop_3d.desc: 3D mode only: a full loop on reverse thrust – also as an outside loop downwards, with the top facing out.
propwash.trick.type.power_matty.desc: A Matty flip with an extra flip: throttle off, one and a half front flips, then keep pitching with throttle until you fly back tail first.
propwash.trick.type.power_roll.desc: A power loop with a full roll at the top, then finish the loop.
propwash.trick.type.proximity.desc: Fly fast within a metre of blocks beside or above you. Closer and longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.reverse_knife_edge.d: Knife edge backwards: on your side, tail first in a straight line for at least half a second.
propwash.trick.type.rewind.desc: Turn past upside down and straight back the same way, as if the video ran backwards – a half roll and back, or a whole flip rewind.
propwash.trick.type.roll.desc: A full turn on the roll axis, left or right. Counts from about 250°.
propwash.trick.type.roll_3d.desc: 3D mode only: a roll where you switch to reverse thrust while upside down instead of dropping. Every extra roll counts.
propwash.trick.type.rubiks_cube.desc: Half flip, full roll, half flip in the same direction – or another quick mix of half flips and rolls on alternating axes.
propwash.trick.type.sbang.desc: Sbang with no dead space: an eject plus at least two quick reversals (split-S, Juicy Flick, rewind …), at most 0.8 s apart. Bonus on top.
propwash.trick.type.segmented.desc: Half a flip or roll, stop upside down for a moment (0.4–0.9 s), then finish in the same direction.
propwash.trick.type.shinobi.desc: Dex combo: a split-S or funky split straight into a Rubik's Cube, then a Matty flip out. Bonus on top of the three tricks.
propwash.trick.type.side_loop.desc: Approach sideways and fly a loop over the obstacle using roll instead of pitch.
propwash.trick.type.side_trippy.aka: Self side trippy, caged side trippy
propwash.trick.type.side_trippy.desc: Circle tightly around a point while lying on your side: the horizon stands vertical and spins. One full lap; every extra lap counts.
propwash.trick.type.snap_roll.desc: Stick in the corner: roll and pitch at full rate at the same time, so the drone tumbles over a slanted axis – like a snap roll in aerobatics.
propwash.trick.type.split_s.desc: Half roll onto your back, then pull through a half loop downwards: reverses direction and loses height.
propwash.trick.type.split_s_540.desc: One and a half rolls to inverted, then pull through like a Split-S: reverses direction and loses height.
propwash.trick.type.splitback.desc: A Split-S with an extra backflip: half roll to inverted, a full backflip, then pull through downwards.
propwash.trick.type.tic_toc.desc: 3D mode only: at least four half flips back and forth, holding upside down on reverse thrust. Every extra half flip counts.
propwash.trick.type.tornado.desc: Roll around your own axis in a steep nose-down dive. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.triple_flip.desc: Three flips in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.triple_roll.desc: Three rolls in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.trippy_spin.desc: Spinning on the yaw axis upside down while you drop or circle around a point. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.vanny_roll.desc: While flying forward, yaw 180° quickly, do a full roll while moving backwards, then yaw another 180° the same way to face forward again.
propwash.trick.type.wall_ride.desc: Glide along a wall or ceiling on your side – at most 1 m away, without touching it.
propwash.trick.type.yaw_spin.desc: A full turn on the yaw axis without flying a curve.
propwash.ui.configurator.title: Configurator
propwash.ui.footer.game: Game setting – applies to all drones
propwash.ui.footer.held: Changes are saved to the drone in your hand
propwash.ui.footer.live: Changes apply to the drone instantly
propwash.ui.footer.mixed: Name: saved in the drone · everything else: all drones
propwash.ui.footer.read_only: View only – nothing to change on this tab
propwash.ui.footer.template: No drone: template for new drones
propwash.ui.guard.airborne: Configurator locked: land and disarm first.
propwash.ui.guard.armed: Configurator locked: disarm the drone first.
propwash.ui.guard.lockout: Arming disabled while the configurator is open
propwash.ui.led.brightness.tip: Brightness of the LEDs and therefore of the FPV headlight.
propwash.ui.led.color.tip: LED color: click a swatch or use the arrow keys. Has no effect in rainbow mode.
propwash.ui.led.desc.armed: Arm status: disarmed, the LEDs pulse slowly in green; armed, they shine steadily in the chosen color.
propwash.ui.led.desc.blink: Blink: on and off twice per second – helps you spot the drone in the air and after a crash.
propwash.ui.led.desc.low_battery: Low battery: the LEDs shine in the chosen color and blink orange once the battery drops below 20%.
propwash.ui.led.desc.rainbow: Rainbow: the colors run along the whole strip.
propwash.ui.led.desc.static: Static: the LEDs always shine in the chosen color.
propwash.ui.led.headlight.tip: In the dark, the strip brightens the FPV view in a light cone in front of the drone. To turn it off just for you: “Video” tab, “LED lighting in FPV view”.
propwash.ui.led.headlight_desc: Headlight on: in caves and at night the strip casts a light cone forward in the FPV view. Near surfaces get brighter than far ones; color and brightness come from the settings above.
propwash.ui.led.headlight_off: Headlight off: the LEDs only work as a marker, the FPV view stays dark in the dark.
propwash.ui.led.installed: Installed: %s with %s LEDs under the nose. Like in Betaflight, the settings live in the drone's flight controller.
propwash.ui.led.missing: This drone has no LED strip. Put one into the bottom accessory slot of the workbench – the settings are stored in the drone anyway.
propwash.ui.led.mode.tip: How the LEDs light up – like Betaflight's LED_STRIP functions: static, blinking, arm status, low-battery warning or rainbow.
propwash.ui.led.no_drone: No drone in your hand: the settings go into the template for new drones.
propwash.ui.led.preview_armed.tip: Shows the preview as if the drone were armed (matters for the “Arm status” mode).
propwash.ui.led.switch_hint: Switch them on and off in flight: the “%s” switch on your radio (tab “Modes”) or the %s key – other players see the drone go dark too. Without an assignment the LEDs always glow.
propwash.ui.led.world.ldl_missing: With the optional mod LambDynamicLights the drone also lights up the world as a real light source. Without it, the light only affects the FPV view.
propwash.ui.led.world.ldl_present: LambDynamicLights detected: the drone is also a real light source in the world – for every player who has the mod installed.
propwash.ui.led.world.shaders: Shader pack active: the headlight only brightens the FPV view as a cone in the middle of the image (no distance), fully black areas stay dark. For real light with shaders, install LambDynamicLights.
propwash.ui.number.invalid: Not a number – fix it or press Esc
propwash.ui.overview.telemetry_hint: Live telemetry appears while you are flying a drone.
propwash.ui.overview.telemetry_missing: No telemetry from the flight model.
propwash.ui.pid.derived_hint: Values follow the build. Editing one switches to manual.
propwash.ui.pid.reset_derived.tip: Drops the manual PID values. The flight model derives them from the build again.
propwash.ui.pid.template_hint: Template: PIDs are derived per build, shown here as an example.
propwash.ui.preset.apply.tip: Applies the chosen preset. Like every change here it is kept with “Save & close”.
propwash.ui.preset.copy.tip: Copies the chosen preset as a short code (starts with PWT1-) to the clipboard – for sharing in chat or on Discord.
propwash.ui.preset.delete.tip: Deletes the chosen preset of your own. Click twice.
propwash.ui.preset.full: At most %s own presets per tab
propwash.ui.preset.name: Preset name
propwash.ui.preset.name.missing: Type a new name into the field first
propwash.ui.preset.paste.invalid: No preset code (PWT1-…) on the clipboard
propwash.ui.preset.paste.tip: Adds the preset from a code on the clipboard to your own presets.
propwash.ui.preset.pid.choice.tip: Pick a preset – built-in or your own – and apply it with the button next to it. “Standard” returns gains, filters, throttle and hold settings to the values derived from the build. The arming angle is kept.
propwash.ui.preset.pid.save.tip: Keeps your changes on this tab as your own preset on this computer (config/propwash/tune_presets.json): hand-set PID gains, filters, throttle and hold settings. Works for every drone; the same name overwrites.
propwash.ui.preset.rates.save.tip: Keeps the current rates (rates type and all three axes) as your own preset on this computer (config/propwash/tune_presets.json). Works for every drone; the same name overwrites.
propwash.ui.preset.rename.tip: Gives the chosen preset of your own the name from the field.
propwash.ui.preset.taken: There already is a preset called “%s”
propwash.ui.rates.preset.tip: Pick a preset – built-in or your own – and apply it with the button next to it. Deadbands are kept.
propwash.ui.settings.apply_template.tip: Drones without their own tune get the template on their first flight.
propwash.ui.settings.arm_angle.any: 180°: arm in any attitude – even in the air and upside down (throttle still fully down).
propwash.ui.settings.arm_angle.level: 0°: arm only when exactly level – practically never.
propwash.ui.settings.arm_angle.limit: Arming works up to %s° of tilt; tilted further, the drone reports “not level”.
propwash.ui.settings.craft_name.hint: The name is saved in the drone (up to 24 characters). A name tag on the placed drone or an anvil works too.
propwash.ui.settings.craft_name.hint_non: Hold a drone or fly one to give it a name. A name tag on a placed drone or an anvil works too.
propwash.ui.settings.craft_name.tip: Name of the drone, shown in the OSD, on the remote and on the goggles. Saved in the drone.
propwash.ui.settings.save_template.tip: Stores this drone's current tune as the template – without manual PIDs, those depend on the build.
propwash.ui.settings.speed_unit.tip: Units for speed, altitude and distance in the configurator and the OSD.
propwash.ui.settings.template_editing: Without a drone, PID tuning and Rates edit the template directly.
propwash.ui.settings.template_empty: It is still empty – “Save as template” fills it.
propwash.ui.settings.template_empty_edit: It is still empty – the values you change there fill it.
propwash.ui.settings.template_live: The template is your default tune for freshly built drones.
propwash.ui.settings.use_template.tip: Takes rates, filters and settings from the template; this drone's PIDs stay.
propwash.ui.tab_error: This tab crashed – see the log for details.
propwash.ui.tab_error.copied: Error copied – paste it into your bug report.
propwash.ui.tab_error.copy: Click here to copy the error for a bug report.
propwash.ui.template.applied: Tune template applied to the new drone.
propwash.ui.tune.filters.gyroLpfHz.tip: Filters gyro noise. Lower = smoother but more delay. Changes the derived PIDs.
propwash.ui.tune.filters.pidLoop.tip: How often the controller runs per second. Faster = more direct.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.altD.tip: Damps climbing and sinking so the drone does not pump.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.altI.tip: Slowly removes steady errors such as weight, battery voltage or downdrafts.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.altP.tip: How firmly ALTHOLD pulls back to the held altitude.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.climbRateCms.tip: Highest climb and descent rate at full or zero throttle.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.midThrottle.tip: On: stick center holds altitude (like Betaflight). Off: the throttle position when switched on holds altitude (like INAV).
propwash.ui.tune.hold.minSatellites.tip: With fewer satellites POSHOLD refuses and only holds altitude.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.posD.tip: Brakes the drone so it does not overshoot the spot.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.posMaxAngleDeg.tip: Largest tilt POSHOLD uses to correct or brake.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.posP.tip: How strongly POSHOLD pulls back to the stored spot.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.stickDeadbandPerce: Beyond this roll or pitch deflection you fly yourself; releasing holds the new spot.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.throttleDeadbandPe: How far the throttle may wander around the hold position before the drone climbs or descends.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.airmode.tip: Full control even at zero throttle – needed for flips and rolls.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.angleStrength.tip: How firmly angle mode pulls back to level.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.antiGravityGain.tip: Boosts the I-term on fast throttle changes against pitch dips.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.armMaxAngleDeg.tip: How far the drone may be tilted when you arm it (like small_angle in Betaflight). Default 25°. 180° lets you arm in any attitude – even in the air and upside down, for example to keep flying after disarming mid-flight. The throttle still has to be fully down (centered in 3D mode). Applies to this drone and travels with its tune.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.horizonStrength.tip: Self-leveling in horizon mode around the stick center.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.itermRelax.tip: Holds back the I-term during fast moves and prevents bounce-back after flips.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.motorIdlePercent.ti: Motor speed at zero throttle while armed.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.d.tip: Damps overshoot but amplifies noise and motor heat.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.ff.tip: Feedforward: reacts directly to stick movement for a crisp response.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.i.tip: Holds attitude against lasting disturbances such as wind or an off-center weight.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.p.tip: How strongly the controller reacts to errors. Too much: oscillation, too little: mushy.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.d.tip: Damps overshoot but amplifies noise and motor heat.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.ff.tip: Feedforward: reacts directly to stick movement for a crisp response.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.i.tip: Holds attitude against lasting disturbances such as wind or an off-center weight.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.p.tip: How strongly the controller reacts to errors. Too much: oscillation, too little: mushy.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleExpo.tip: Finer throttle control around throttle mid.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleLimitPercen: Maximum throttle when the limit is active.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleLimitType.t: Limits throttle: scales the whole travel or clips the top.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleMid.tip: Stick point the throttle expo pivots around.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.thrustLinearPercent: Compensates the propellers' non-linear thrust curve.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.tpaMode.tip: Which terms get attenuated at high throttle.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.tpaRatePercent.tip: How much the PIDs are attenuated at full throttle.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.vbatSagCompensation: Keeps the flight feel constant as the battery voltage drops.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.d.tip: Damps overshoot but amplifies noise and motor heat.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.ff.tip: Feedforward: reacts directly to stick movement for a crisp response.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.i.tip: Holds attitude against lasting disturbances such as wind or an off-center weight.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.p.tip: How strongly the controller reacts to errors. Too much: oscillation, too little: mushy.
Shapes the curve: more expo = finer around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.centerRateD: Rotation rate in °/s per stick travel around the center.
Rotation rate in °/s at full stick deflection.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.rcExpo.tip: Softens the center without changing the max rate.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.rcRate.tip: Base sensitivity over the whole stick travel.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.superRate.t: Raises the rotation rate towards the end of the stick.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.rcDeadband.tip: Range around the stick center that counts as zero for roll and pitch.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.actualExpo.t: Shapes the curve: more expo = finer around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.centerRateDp: Rotation rate in °/s per stick travel around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.maxRateDps.t: Rotation rate in °/s at full stick deflection.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.rcExpo.tip: Softens the center without changing the max rate.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.rcRate.tip: Base sensitivity over the whole stick travel.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.superRate.ti: Raises the rotation rate towards the end of the stick.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.type.tip: Betaflight: RC rate, super rate, expo. Actual: center rate, max rate, expo – easier to read.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.actualExpo.ti: Shapes the curve: more expo = finer around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.centerRateDps: Rotation rate in °/s per stick travel around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.maxRateDps.ti: Rotation rate in °/s at full stick deflection.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.rcExpo.tip: Softens the center without changing the max rate.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.rcRate.tip: Base sensitivity over the whole stick travel.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.superRate.tip: Raises the rotation rate towards the end of the stick.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yawDeadband.tip: Range around the stick center that counts as zero for yaw.
propwash.video.channel.choice.tip:
Automatic: when the drone takes off, the server gives it a channel no other pilot is using.
Fixed channel: always stays the same, like a VTX you set by hand.
propwash.video.channel.footer: Channel: saved in the drone · spectating: all drones
propwash.video.channel.info_auto: Automatic: at takeoff the server picks a free channel – R1, R2, F2, F4, R7 and R8 first, the proven race line-up. The channel is shown in the OSD (VTX).
propwash.video.channel.info_auto_digital: Automatic: at takeoff the server picks a free digital channel – CH1 to CH8 in order. The channel is shown in the OSD (VTX).
propwash.video.channel.info_manual: Fixed channel: the server never changes it – agree on channels with the other pilots. The channel is shown in the OSD (VTX).
propwash.video.channel.label: %s · %s MHz
propwash.video.channel.no_drone: No drone: hold a drone or fly one to set its channel.
propwash.video.config.camera_shake.toolt: Fine shake of the FPV image like a real camera on the frame: a faint motor buzz (clearly stronger with damaged props or motors), plus buffeting in your own prop wash, close to the ground and walls at low speed, and a jolt on hard punch-outs. At high speed the image stays calm. Image only, flight physics stay unchanged. 100%% is the default, 0%% turns it off.
propwash.video.config.creative.latency.t: Delay between the drone camera and the goggles.
propwash.video.config.creative.noise.too: Extra analog noise, independent of the signal.
propwash.video.config.creative.obstructi: Blocks between you and the drone weaken the signal. Only applies with a limited range.
propwash.video.config.creative.range.too: Distance at which the video and radio signal start to fade. With a limited range the picture behaves like the drone's video system; unlimited lifts the radio range too.
propwash.video.config.format.tooltip: 16:9 fills the whole window as before. 4:3 shows the image like a 4:3 camera in 4:3 goggles: the same field of view across, more image above and below, black bars left and right; the OSD sits inside the 4:3 image. Auto follows the drone's video system: analog 4:3, digital 16:9 – also while spectating. Action cam recordings stay 16:9.
propwash.video.config.format_line.boxed: Image format 4:3: %s° wide × %s° high – more image above and below, black bars left and right.
propwash.video.config.format_line.wide: Image format 16:9: %s° wide × %s° high, fills the whole window.
propwash.video.config.fov.tooltip: Custom horizontal field of view of the creative goggles. Wide values feel faster but distort more.
propwash.video.config.fov_line.fallback: Video unit “%s” without its own value: %s° horizontal (default of the video system).
propwash.video.config.fov_line.module: Camera of the video unit “%s”: %s° horizontal.
propwash.video.config.fov_line.none: The field of view comes from the camera in the video unit of the drone you fly or hold.
propwash.video.config.fov_line.own: Creative goggles with a custom field of view: %s° horizontal, independent of the video unit.
propwash.video.config.fov_module.tooltip: The field of view comes from the camera in the drone's video unit – just like in real life. Analog and digital goggles use it; a different field of view means a different video unit.
propwash.video.config.fov_source.tooltip: Creative goggles: field of view like the camera in the drone's video unit, or set freely (sandbox).
propwash.video.config.latency_source.too: Creative goggles: picture delayed like the drone's video transmitter (laps count) or set freely. Less latency than the transmitter doesn't count for leaderboards; the creative goggles' range, obstacles and breakup never count as a flight aid.
propwash.video.config.led_lighting.toolt: Just for you: at night and in caves the LED strip lights up the FPV view in a light cone. Turn it off if the view goes black or glitchy with it on your computer. The LEDs themselves and what other players see stay the same.
propwash.video.config.no_goggles: Put on FPV goggles – this tab then shows the settings of exactly those goggles. Which goggles you wear decides what applies; it cannot be switched here.
propwash.video.config.reduce_flicker.too: Softens fast brightness changes, rolling bars and picture rolls, fades signal loss in gently and lowers the noise rate. Recommended for light sensitivity.
propwash.video.config.renderer.tooltip: “Full” shows every image effect. The simple overlay is lighter and works with shader packs; it is used automatically when the full effects can't run.
propwash.video.config.retry.tooltip: Try the video or headlight shader again after an error (for example after switching resource packs or graphics drivers).
propwash.video.config.strength.tooltip: How strongly image interference is shown. Signal loss and frozen frames still happen at 0%%.
propwash.video.config.title: Video

propwash.video.flashback.result.no_sessi: You can only record while flying a drone

propwash.video.mismatch.hint: Take the goggles off to fly line of sight, or wear matching goggles
propwash.video.no_goggles.hint: Put on FPV goggles to see the camera feed.

propwash.video.record.failed.title: Video not saved

propwash.video.record.tab.encoder.toolti: Uses a hardware encoder of your graphics card or processor (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMD AMF, VideoToolbox) if ffmpeg is installed – that frees the processor and handles 1080p60 easily. Without ffmpeg, or if the hardware encoder fails, Propwash's own encoder takes over. Whether ffmpeg was found is shown under “Faster recording with ffmpeg” below.
Always records with Propwash's own encoder on the processor – no extra program needed. It uses several processor cores; on slower computers choose 720p or 30 fps.

propwash.video.record.tab.flashback_auto: If Flashback isn't recording yet, the Record button starts a Flashback recording as well and finishes it when the camera path ends – Flashback then saves the replay as usual. Off: the Action Cam (Flashback) only records while you record with Flashback yourself.
propwash.video.record.tab.flashback_dens: One keyframe per tick (20 per second): exactly as flown, every turn at the right moment – but many keyframes in Flashback's timeline.

Only as many keyframes as needed – easier to edit in Flashback. The path stays within about 1 cm of your flight, but between keyframes Flashback evens out the speed, so the camera may run up to about 0.3 blocks ahead or behind.
propwash.video.record.tab.fps.tooltip: Frames per second in the video. If the game runs slower, the video repeats frames so length and speed stay right.
propwash.video.record.tab.grain.tooltip: Subtle sensor noise only in very dark parts of the picture, like a real small camera (a little more on the Light cam than on the Heavy cam). Off = noise-free picture.
propwash.video.record.tab.hint: %1$s starts and stops recording while flying FPV (rebind it in the “Keys” tab). On the radio: function “%2$s” in the “Modes” tab – a switch records while it is on, a button starts and stops with every press. The REC indicator is an OSD element in the “OSD” tab. The action cam records the clean camera image without OSD and without radio interference, as MP4 (H.264, optionally with sound).
propwash.video.record.tab.hint.flashback: With the Action Cam (Flashback) on top, the same button records a camera path for Flashback instead of a video: open the replay in Flashback and pick the scene “Propwash · Flight …” to render, cut or change it.

%1$s starts and stops the camera path for Flashback – in FPV and in line of sight (rebind it in the “Keys” tab). On the radio: function “%2$s” in the “Modes” tab. The Action Cam (Flashback) records no video itself: resolution, frame rate, quality, stabilization and sound above only apply to the Action Cam (Light) and (Heavy).
propwash.video.record.tab.indicator.tool: Shows notices at the top center while recording (paused, cam battery low, and which part of the computer limits the recording – game, graphics card, encoder, drive or frame buffer – with a tip) and the saving progress outside FPV. The REC indicator itself is an OSD element: show, hide or move it in the “OSD” tab. Neither ever appears in the video.
propwash.video.record.tab.open_folder.to: Opens the propwash/recordings folder in the game directory.
propwash.video.record.tab.quality.toolti: High: close to lossless, even in dark scenes and fast pans. At %s about %s MB per minute, at most %s MB/min.
Small: small files for sharing, fine detail gets softer. At %s about %s MB per minute, at most %s MB/min.
Standard: clean picture with manageable files, recommended. At %s about %s MB per minute, at most %s MB/min. Quality stays the same, calm scenes simply get smaller.
propwash.video.record.tab.recordings.too: All videos with thumbnail, date, length and size – play, delete or open the folder. It also shows how far saving has got.
propwash.video.record.tab.resolution.too: Video size (16:9). The Light cam goes up to 1080p, the Heavy cam up to 1440p. Larger means sharper, but more processing and bigger files.
Heavy cam only: smooths and keeps the horizon level – at 50% strength up to about ±22° of bank, beyond that it follows; the picture gets much tighter.
Raw camera image, like the Light cam, which has no stabilization.
Heavy cam only: smooths fast shakes using the known camera attitude; the picture gets tighter by the crop shown under Strength.

propwash.video.record.tab.strength.toolt: How strongly the Heavy cam steadies its picture. More strength holds the picture calmer and the horizon over a wider bank angle, but crops tighter. The picture is cut from the full-resolution game image before it is scaled down: if your game window is larger than the video by at least the crop factor, stabilizing costs no sharpness.
